title: chore(claude): prune the dead launch.json entry, and the convention that left it
body:
Fixes #14596

`.claude/launch.json` carried two named configurations. One of them, `pr3505-attach-3477`, had its `runtimeArgs` rooted at `/home/user/objectstack-pr3505/examples/app-showcase` — a worktree that no longer exists. This deletes it, and adds the one line that stops the next one accumulating.

Scope is the triage ruling on the card (comment 5515018220): the delete, plus the prune line. Options 2 (a gate over every `runtimeArgs` path) and 3 (stop checking session configs in) are deliberately untouched.

## What the measurement said

At `origin/main` `5bc2f27`:

- `.claude/launch.json` carried exactly **2** configurations, `showcase-dogfood-3777` and `pr3505-attach-3477`.
- `ls /home/user/objectstack-pr3505` returns "No such file or directory". The live worktree list is the shared checkout plus three issue worktrees, none of them `objectstack-pr3505`.
- Nothing outside `.claude/launch.json` names the dead config: `git grep -n "pr3505" -- . ':!.claude/launch.json'` exits 1 with zero lines, while the **same term without the exclusion** hits three lines inside `launch.json`. The zero is a true zero, not a broken pattern.

Population is still two entries, one stale — below the revisit trigger the triage wrote down (five or more entries, or two or more stale). That is why this PR is a delete and a line, and not a gate.

## The convention half

The dead entry was not an author's slip. The dogfood skill's section 0 tells every session to add a named config pointing at its own working directory, and nothing told anyone to take it back out — a dead entry is the expected end state of a correct process. So section 0 gains one line, as a continuation of the same checkbox that owns the add, leaving that bullet carrying the entry's whole lifecycle:

```text
      工作树没了就**删掉自己那条** —— 死条目让 `preview_start` 挂在缺失的 `pnpm -C` 上。
```

A continuation line rather than a new checkbox, deliberately: section 0 is a **takeoff** checklist and a prune is not tickable at takeoff, so a separate item there would be one nobody can satisfy when they read it. Placing it in the bullet that already says "add one" is also what the triage asked for — beside the existing instruction.

## The other consumer, measured rather than assumed

`.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` routes to this same section ("先隔离,再执行(照 dogfood §0)"), so the open question was whether it restates the add-without-prune instruction and would need the same line. It does not — it never names `launch.json` at all. Measured with `grep -rn "launch\.json" .claude/skills/checklist-test/` (exit 1, zero lines) against a positive control for `dogfood` in the same directory (exit 0, five hits), so the empty result is a real absence rather than a wrong path. No edit there and nothing to file.

Repo-wide, `launch.json` is named only in the dogfood SKILL.md (lines 35 and 52) and in three `packages/cli` files that merely describe it in prose.

## Verification

`.claude/launch.json` after the delete — proved, not assumed:

```
node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('.claude/launch.json','utf8'))"  → exit 0
configurations: 1 · names: ["showcase-dogfood-3777"] · its -C target: "examples/app-showcase" (resolves)
trailing-comma scan  grep -n ",[[:space:]]*[]}]" .claude/launch.json  → exit 1 (none)
```

The diff on that file is a **pure deletion** (18 lines, 0 insertions): git matched the closing brace and removed the separating comma with the object, so no line was rewritten.

Line ratchet, from the gate's own verdict line — `.claude/skills/dogfood-verification/SKILL.md` **147 → 148 lines** (ceiling 157, headroom 10 → 9):

```
✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/dogfood-verification/SKILL.md is 148 lines (ceiling 157; headroom 9).
✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/dogfood-verification/SKILL.md: widest table row is 0 bytes (pin 0; headroom 0).
```

No table row was added, so the 0-byte widest-row pin is untouched. The added line is 115 bytes, under the gate's 120-byte line rule.

### Gates

All run at the final commit `4f8d0b9f`, derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths — the script takes its own change set from the merge base). Each exit code captured by redirect before any pipe.

| Gate | Exit | Its own verdict line |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `check-closing-keyword-parity` | 0 | OK (3 parsers agree on all 9 keywords and both measured separators; sweep found 5 file(s) carrying the grammar across 8160 tracked file(s), all registered). |
| `check-comment-mask-corpus` | 0 | comment-mask corpus sweep: 5824 files, 0 disagree, 0 unparseable |
| `check:doc-formula-expressions` | 0 | 22 record-scoped formula example(s) across 426 files / 1365 TS blocks judged clean |
| `check:agent-test-spelling` | 0 | 0 violations — 432 file(s) · 5851 bare separator token(s) · 1389 launcher-rooted run(s) |
| `check:doc-authoring` | 0 | 393 files clean; 46 published skill files clean — no internal issue-id references |
| `check:nul-bytes` | 0 | OK (scanned 8153 text file(s); no raw ASCII control bytes). |
| `check:pm-governed-merges` | 0 | self-test 243 assertions; live: the real generator declared 9 output(s) and certified this tree |
| `check:pm-skill-ratchet` | 0 | 148 lines (ceiling 157; headroom 9) — quoted in full above |
| `check:refd-timer-probe` | 0 | 5819 source file(s) swept; the probe is read in one file and nowhere else. |
| `check:skill-frame-sync` | 0 | 2 copies of the decision frame are structurally isomorphic across 2 files |
| `check:watch-hint-literal` | 0 | 48 declaration(s) across 4 rostered name(s); no unrostered spelling in the tree. |
| `check:pm-skill-id-lint` | 0 | 23 file(s) clean (pattern for a 3-or-more-digit issue id) — the new line carries no issue number |

`check:pm-skill-id-lint` is not in the derived set; it is run because the diff edits `.claude/skills/**` and the new line had to be proved free of an issue id.

`check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited **3**, its own `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` code — "Nothing was measured: this gate exited before running a single check". That is not a finding. It named `@objectstack/formula` and then `@objectstack/lint` as unbuilt; after building both it exits 0 with the verdict above.

### ESLint

Not run repo-wide — narrowed, and the narrowing is measured rather than asserted. ESLint's **own** config resolution excludes both changed files: `npx eslint --format json` on the two paths returns 2 entries, 0 errors, each carrying `File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied`. And the diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict, because `eslint.config.mjs` states this repo "never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed `@typescript-eslint` rules) for ANY file". A JSON deletion and one Markdown line have nothing for `pnpm lint` to read.

## Landing

⛔ **Draft, and merged by hand.** The diff touches `.claude/**`, a governed surface under Prime Directive #14 — no seat merges it, queues it, arms auto-merge, or flips it ready, and no agent seat approves it. `skip-changeset` is applied: this diff publishes nothing from any package.
